item.title: Apple Launches Apple Intelligence for Home with HomeKit Secure Video
item.description:
Apple Launches Apple Intelligence for Home with HomeKit Secure Video

With the release of iOS 27, Apple has introduced Apple Intelligence for Home, bringing AI-powered text descriptions and video analysis to its HomeKit Secure Video (HKSV) service.

🔍 Overview

Apple Intelligence for Home enables compatible cameras to provide natural-language descriptions of activity, such as “someone delivered a package,” “a cat played in the room,” or “A dog sat on the floor.” This capability joins other major security camera providers, including Ring, Google Nest, Blink, Wyze, and Arlo, who offer similar text descriptions combining motion triggers with Vision Language Models.

⚙️ Key details

Apple Intelligence adds several new capabilities to the existing smart alerts, facial recognition, and 10 days of video storage provided by HomeKit Secure Video:

  • Natural-language video search: Users can search through video content using natural language.
  • Event management: The system surfaces “noteworthy” events and can stitch relevant clips together.
  • Notification control: A “reduce notifications” feature combines related events into a single updating alert (enabled by default).
  • Video summaries: A “summarize videos” feature is available (disabled by default).

🚀 Availability

To use these features, users require the following:

  • An AI-capable iPhone running iOS 27
  • A HomeKit Secure Video-compatible camera
  • An Apple Home Hub running HomePod/tvOS 27
  • An iCloud Plus plan

💰 Pricing and Tiers

Apple Intelligence for Home is bundled into specific iCloud Plus plans. All tiers supporting Apple Intelligence also include basic HKSV features for unlimited cameras.

iCloud Plus Plan Monthly Cost Camera Limit for Apple Intelligence
2TB Plan $9.99 (or Apple One $39.95) One camera
6TB Plan $29.99 Two cameras
12TB Plan $59.99 Up to five cameras

No tier supports more than five cameras. For comparison, standard HKSV recording starts at $0.99 for one camera (50GB plan), $2.99 for five (200GB), and $9.99 for unlimited (2TB). Other platforms, such as Amazon’s Ring and Google Home’s Nest, charge $20 a month for their respective AI features and recording options for unlimited cameras.

#AppleIntelligence #HomeKit #SmartHome #ComputerVision #iOS27

Source: Apple is making your security camera smarter. What comes next is more interesting.

item.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo and Intelligent Personal Hub Under New CEO John Ternus
item.description:
Apple Announces iPhone Duo and Intelligent Personal Hub Under New CEO John Ternus

Apple has announced a big new product, the iPhone Duo, during a major product launch. The event marked the first major launch led by Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, who took over the role from former CEO Tim Cook less than two weeks prior.

🔍 Overview

  • First Foldable Smartphone: The announcement represents the official debut of the iPhone Duo, which is Apple’s first foldable smartphone.
  • Leadership Transition: This is the first major product launch under new CEO John Ternus since he succeeded Tim Cook.

⚙️ Intelligent Personal Hub and AI

At the start of the launch event, the very first announcement made by John Ternus was focused on the intelligent personal hub.

This release builds on Apple’s involvement in the AI space. The company has been in the AI game for two years since launching Apple Intelligence at WWDC in 2024, which has previously been a mishmash of things.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #JohnTernus #AppleIntelligence

Source: Can John Ternus find Apple’s next big thing?

item.title: Apple Settles Class Action Lawsuit Over AI-Upgraded Siri Rollout Delays
item.description:
Apple Settles Class Action Lawsuit Over AI-Upgraded Siri Rollout Delays

Apple has agreed to a $250 million settlement to resolve claims that the company failed to deliver an AI-upgraded version of Siri as expected. While Apple denies any wrongdoing, the settlement allows eligible iPhone owners to submit claims for a payout.

⚙️ Key details

The class action lawsuit alleged that Apple established a clear consumer expectation that AI features showcased at WWDC 2024 would be available upon the launch of the iPhone 16. Although marketed as “built for Apple Intelligence,” the devices launched with a more limited set of capabilities. The promised AI-upgraded Siri was subsequently delayed and only released recently with iOS 27.

🚀 Eligibility and Claims

Individuals who purchased specific iPhone models in the United States between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to participate. To file a claim, users must provide their name, contact information, and device serial number on the settlement website by December 21, 2026.

Eligible Device Model
iPhone 15 Pro
iPhone 15 Pro Max
iPhone 16 models

💰 Payout Information

The estimated payout is $25 per eligible device. However, this amount may increase to as much as $95 depending on the total volume of claims submitted.

#Apple #Siri #AppleIntelligence #ClassAction #Lawsuit

Source: iPhone owners can now submit claims in Apple’s $250 million Siri AI settlement

item.title: Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms
item.description:
Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms

Apple has begun rolling out Siri AI, the next generation of Apple Intelligence, alongside powerful parental controls and software improvements across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and other Apple platforms.

🔍 Overview

Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence. It is deeply integrated into iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, offering a more conversational assistant with broad world knowledge and personal context understanding.

⚙️ Key Details

Feature Capability
Siri AI Understands personal context across emails, messages, and photos; utilizes onscreen awareness and web access for up-to-date information.
Siri Mode Integrated into the iPhone Camera app to take action on things in front of the user, such as splitting bills via Apple Cash or adding Wallet passes.
Visual Intelligence Allows users on iPhone, iPad, and Mac to ask about screen content; Vision Pro users can ask about their surroundings.
Write with Siri Generates drafts or refines existing text based on user descriptions.
Siri App Uses iCloud to privately sync conversational history across all user products.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Tools Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of price drops or restocks, and enables custom extensions.
Call Context Surfaces reservation numbers or confirmation codes when calling a business.
Photos Tools Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool.

🛡️ Parental Controls

New intuitive features allow parents to manage digital experiences for children:

  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Ask to Browse: Requires parental approval before children access new websites in Safari.
  • Communication Safety: Detects and blocks violent content or gore in shared images and videos; allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: Offers an at-a-glance view of average usage and top apps, with the ability to set daily time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.
  • Schedules: Manages app access at different points of the day.
  • Setup Flow: A new process for child accounts to enable age-based safeguards across the system.

🚀 Availability

Siri AI is currently rolling out as a beta in English. Support for Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, and French is scheduled for October.

💡 Why it matters

The 2027 software releases introduce platform improvements in connectivity, search, and performance. Specific performance gains include:

  • Apps launch up to 30 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.
  • Photos load up to 70 percent faster after being taken on iPhone and iPad.
  • AirDrop transfers are up to 80 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.

#Apple #SiriAI #AppleIntelligence #iOS27 #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available

item.title: Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements
item.description:
Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements

Apple has released software updates delivering a new generation of Apple Intelligence features and platform improvements for its devices, including the 2027 software releases.

🧠 Apple Intelligence Features

Apple Intelligence introduces tools to make daily apps smarter and more useful:

Feature Capability
Photos Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool for editing photos.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of website changes (price drops or restocks), and enables custom extensions based on descriptions.
Call Context Surfaces relevant information, such as reservation numbers or confirmation codes, during business calls.

🛡️ Parental Controls and Safety

New features allow parents to create safer digital experiences for children:

  • Account Setup: A new flow for child accounts simplifies enabling age-based safeguards.
  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Safari: “Ask to Browse” requires parental approval before children access new websites.
  • Communication Safety: Blocks gore or violent content in shared images and videos, and allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: A redesigned intuitive view shows average device usage and top apps. This includes Schedules to manage app access at different times of the day and daily total time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.

⚙️ Platform and Performance Improvements

The 2027 software releases include several performance and design refinements:

  • Speed Increases:
    • iPhone and iPad: Apps launch up to 30% faster, photos load up to 70% faster, and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster.
    • iPad: File browsing and transfers to external USB drives are up to 5x faster; improvements to multitasking window management.
    • Apple Vision Pro: Wi-Fi connection and startup are up to 3x faster.
    • Apple Watch: Faster music playback.
  • Connectivity and Stability:
    • Seamless transitions between cellular and Wi-Fi on iPhone and iPad.
    • Messages now allows subsequent texts to go through while large media is being delivered in low-bandwidth situations.
    • Faster network file browsing on Mac.
    • More stable and comprehensive search across Mail, Photos, and Spotlight, with a new ranking system for Top Hits in Mail.
  • Design: Refinements using “Liquid Glass” include sharper app icons and a Settings slider to adjust the appearance from ultraclear to fully tinted.

#AppleIntelligence #iOS #macOS #SoftwareUpdate #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available

item.title: Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates
item.description:
Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates

Apple has announced that its next generation of software updates, first unveiled at WWDC26, will be released on Monday, September 14. These updates will be available as free downloads for compatible devices across the Apple ecosystem.

⚙️ Key details

The updates introduce major upgrades including design refinements, performance improvements, and updates to various apps. A primary focus of the release is the introduction of new Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features.

Operating System Key Features and Improvements
iOS 27 Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, Visual Intelligence, expanded customization, and upgrades to Photos, Safari, Messages, Mail, Passwords, Shortcuts, and Home
iPadOS 27 Apple Intelligence features and iPad-specific productivity improvements
macOS 27 Golden Gate Siri AI, Visual Intelligence, Apple Intelligence features, and performance improvements
watchOS 27 New Siri, fitness, health, and Smart Stack capabilities

🚀 Availability

In addition to the major operating systems, Apple is releasing tvOS 27, visionOS 27, HomePod software 27, and new AirPods firmware on September 14. Following developer betas in June and public betas in July, users can install the updates via the following methods:

  • iPhone and iPad: Settings > General > Software Update
  • Mac: System Settings > General > Software Update
  • Apple Watch: Through the Watch app on a paired iPhone
  • Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro: Through Settings

#Apple #iOS27 #AppleIntelligence #SiriAI #SoftwareUpdate

Source: Apple confirms release dates for iOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27 and more

item.title: Apple to hold Surprise and shine presentation on September 9, 2026
item.description:
Apple to hold Surprise and shine presentation on September 9, 2026

Apple has announced its annual autumn presentation, titled “Surprise and shine,” scheduled for September 9, 2026. This event marks the first major presentation under the leadership of new CEO John Turnus. The broadcast will begin at 10:00 Pacific Time and will be available via the Apple website, Apple TV, and YouTube.

🔍 Overview

The event is expected to prioritize premium devices, with a focus on high-end hardware. Anticipated announcements include:

  • The first foldable iPhone
  • iPhone 18 Pro
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max

⚙️ Key details

The foldable iPhone is expected to feature a clamshell design, offering a standard external display that unfolds into a compact tablet. Reports indicate the external OLED display will measure approximately 5.5 inches.

Device Feature Expected Detail
Foldable iPhone Design Clamshell, tablet-sized internal screen
iPhone 18 Pro/Max Camera Possible variable aperture
Software Siri New generation powered by Apple Intelligence

Additional expectations for the new iPhone lineup include updated processors, improved battery life, camera upgrades, and further reduction of the elements surrounding the Dynamic Island.

🚀 Availability

Following the focus on premium devices at this autumn event, more affordable models are expected to be carried over to a spring 2027 launch. Analysts suggest the foldable iPhone may be priced between $2,000 and $2,500 depending on the configuration. Long-term projections suggest this category could generate tens of billions of dollars in revenue by the end of 2027.

#Apple #iPhone #Technology #AppleIntelligence #Foldable

Source: Apple Event 2026: what Apple will unveil on 9 September
